promotion_activity_id.description: promotion id from coupon query API's field "dsCouponId"

try_to_pay.description: Please auth your account as DS Before set it true

business_model.description: "wholesale" for wholesale model, "retail" for retail model

customize_sku_map.description: key is sku_id, value is customize_id

birthday.description: 收件人生日，当收货国家为巴西（BR）时，此字段为必填项。 格式： ddMMyyyy（日-月-年，8位数字，无分隔符）。 示例： 01022026 代表 2026年2月1日。

out_order_id.description: outer order id, used for idempotent checkout

foreigner_passport_no.description: foreign tax number (registration card number or passport number is required for Korean foreigners)
